extracted.intended_audience: Agency program and support directorate staff preparing the Annual OMB Management Improvement Plan/Report under OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and consolidation of a directorate/agency Annual OMB Management Improvement Plan/Report (per OMB Circular A-44), documenting management improvements, cost reductions, and formatting the submission to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to established reporting criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: The consolidated report should follow the guidelines with respect to the criteria established for reporting accomplishments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo praises those who 'did an excellent job following the guidelines with respect to the criteria established for reporting accomplishments' — compliance with those (not-detailed-here) criteria materially assists in preparing the Agency report to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format compliance / presentation format
rubrics_metrics.description: The report must follow the prescribed format for presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format conformity is explicitly noted as important — following the required presentation format will assist in preparing and consolidating the Agency report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document concrete cost reductions and efficiency improvements
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate concrete efforts to reduce cost and increase efficiency in support and administrative activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support and administrative costs are subject to severe scrutiny in the resource allocation process; concrete, documented cost-reduction and efficiency accomplishments strengthen the Agency's ability to defend those resource levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation quality / completeness of Directorate report
rubrics_metrics.description: The consolidated directorate report should accurately reflect the management improvement and reports-reduction efforts across the directorate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A conscientious, well-assembled consolidated report that reflects the Directorate's accomplishments will form the core of the Agency report to OMB and is specifically commended.
